site.name: Rajeev Jasti
site.description: Portfolio of Rajeev Jasti, Principal Data Engineer specializing in enterprise data platforms, backend services, and AI-enabled web applications.

groups.heading: Data Engineering & Modeling (OLAP)
bullets: Architected multi-source ingestion pipelines using PySpark, Matillion, and Boomi (CDC, watermark extracts, SaaS APIs, flat files) into Amazon Redshift, decoupling batch and near-real-time streaming via Amazon SQS for automated staging, deduplication, cleansing, and SQL business transformations.

Designed enterprise star and snowflake dimensional models, and developed LookML semantic models and Explores for core supply chain metrics (inventory turns, dock-to-stock cycle times, order fill rates, freight spend) with optimized datagroups and PDT lifecycle policies.

Implemented reverse-ETL pipelines syncing curated data back into Salesforce and Zoho, and partnered with cross-functional stakeholders (Operations, Sales, Finance) to deliver executive Looker dashboards standardizing KPIs across departments.

groups.heading: Backend & Middleware
bullets: Architected enterprise-grade serverless REST APIs and asynchronous order ingestion middleware using AWS API Gateway, Lambda, SQS FIFO, and Step Functions (Saga pattern), reliably fanning out multi-channel B2B/B2C orders to legacy ERP, WMS, and inventory distribution systems.
Engineered a distributed DynamoDB caching layer with SHA-256 payload fingerprinting and native TTL eviction, cutting primary database load by 30–50%.
Sustained 99.9% transaction completion through idempotent request handling, API Gateway throttling, DLQ redrive policies, exponential backoff, and circuit breakers.
Developed a high-concurrency Available-to-Promise (ATP) inventory reservation microservice using atomic conditional writes and distributed locks to prevent overselling.
Implemented a dual-engine search strategy combining Elasticsearch with SQL Server for sub-second search across millions of historical orders and invoices.

groups.heading: Database Systems (OLTP)
bullets: Owned OLTP database architecture and administration running mission-critical order-to-cash operations across pricing, rebates, commissions, and ERP/WMS/TMS integration feeds.

Architected the enterprise pricing engine in SQL Server, resolving sales-rep overrides, customer contract pricing, commodity pricing, COGS, and discount layers into real-time customer–item–DC prices via ACID-compliant T-SQL procedures.
Scaled the pricing API to sustain 100,000–200,000 executions/min at sub-100 ms latency with zero deadlocks under heavy concurrent load.

Modeled SCD Type 2 temporal pricing for point-in-time auditability, and engineered PriceIQ statistical pricing using IQR outlier fencing and skew-adjusted distribution analysis to intelligently price custom setups.
Built the vendor rebate calculation platform, sales commission payroll, and WMS/TMS activity-based incentive payroll.

groups.heading: Database Administration & Reliability (OLTP & OLAP)
bullets: Eliminated high-frequency lock-conversion deadlocks, write skew, and reader–writer blocking across high-throughput OLTP workloads by pairing targeted locking hints (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK, ROWLOCK) with deterministic UPSERT ordering and tuning Read Committed Snapshot Isolation (RCSI).
Resolved tempdb spills, parameter sniffing, and bookmark lookups through execution plan profiling, memory grant tuning, composite clustered/covering index redesigns, and table partitioning.
Automated enterprise maintenance, index defragmentation, and statistics via Ola Hallengren on SQL Server Agent, administered Always On Availability Groups (HA/DR), and tuned CDC replication.

Optimized Amazon Redshift storage architectures (KEY/ALL/EVEN distribution, sort keys, AZ64/ZSTD compression), WLM parameter queues, materialized views, PII data encryption, RBAC, and CloudWatch performance alarms.

groups.heading: Cloud Architecture & Modernization
bullets: Architected and provisioned an enterprise-scale, fault-tolerant AWS cloud foundation spanning multi-AZ VPCs, API Gateway, Lambda, Step Functions, SQS FIFO, DynamoDB, and Amazon Redshift.

Deployed a secure, auto-scaled internal application tier on AWS (EC2 in multi-AZ VPCs, Auto Scaling, hardened security groups, Route 53, Apache HTTPD reverse proxies) with automated open-source TLS rotation.

Engineered an event-driven Master Data Management (MDM) ecosystem across Zoho, establishing governed golden records for customer, item, and supplier entities with automated webhook and message-queued distribution to tier-1 ERP, WMS, and TMS systems to eliminate synchronization lag and discrepancies across warehouse fulfillment and freight routing networks.

groups.heading: DevOps & Infrastructure
bullets: Established end-to-end operational reliability, automated maintenance, and proactive infrastructure observability across distributed cloud microservices and database clusters.
Automated enterprise SQL Server maintenance, index defragmentation, and statistics updates using Ola Hallengren orchestrated via SQL Server Agent.
Built robust monitoring and alerting in SolarWinds (waits, blocking, resource pressure) and AWS CloudWatch (disk spill, CPU utilization, concurrency metrics).

Authored custom T-SQL health audit scripts, enforced least-privilege RBAC, and implemented resilient fault-tolerance mechanisms including automated Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) redrives, exponential backoff, circuit breakers, and zero-downtime automated TLS certificate rotations.

groups.heading: Generative AI & Web Applications
bullets: Integrated Google's Model Context Protocol (MCP) server in Looker, exposing curated semantic definitions, Explores, and supply chain KPIs to generative AI agents to enable natural-language-to-SQL querying and prompt-driven analytical dashboard generation.

Engineered high-throughput, asynchronous FastAPI backend microservices with strict Pydantic schema validation, standardizing departmental custom data capture and preventing operational data corruption across downstream pipelines.
Delivered responsive, high-performance web applications and internal portals featuring seamless API integrations and granular role-based access control.

persona.$comment: Feeds the Bedrock chat persona's 'Key Information' block. Describing THIS SITE accurately matters: the previous hand-maintained copy claimed a Three.js frontend, which the repository has never had.
summary: Current Role: Principal Data Engineer at Nicholas and Company (Nov 2022 – Present, Salt Lake City & Remote)
Previous Role: Data Engineer at Nicholas and Company (Feb 2018 – Oct 2022)
Specialization: Enterprise Data Engineering & OLAP modeling, OLTP Database Engines, Real-time Streaming, Cloud Migrations, Full-Stack & Generative AI Web Applications
Backend Stack: Python 3.10+, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy ORM (asyncpg), Alembic, Amazon Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, Boomi, Docker, Kafka, microservices
Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (Redshift, Bedrock, S3, Glue, Lambda, Athena, DynamoDB, API Gateway, CloudWatch, EKS, ECS, EC2, RDS), Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD
Principles: enterprise-grade patterns, performant async processing, high-availability reliability, strict ACID transactions, modular architecture.
siteFacts: This portfolio is a hand-written static single-page app with no frontend framework — no React, Vue, Svelte, jQuery, Three.js or CSS preprocessor. It is vanilla ES modules, hand-authored CSS, and a 2D-canvas animated background. (The file named three-bg.js is a plain 2D canvas renderer; the name is historical.)

Frontend: vanilla JavaScript ES modules, hand-written CSS, 2D-canvas backgrounds, a service worker and Web App Manifest (installable PWA), DOMPurify and marked vendored from npm, and self-hosted subset fonts. No asset is loaded from a third-party origin.

Frontend features: hash-routed sections, an interactive command prompt with a Ctrl+K palette, a live session-activity dashboard fed by server-sent events, this AI chat, a theme customizer, and a full account UI (register, login, TOTP 2FA, magic links, password reset, session management).

Backend: FastAPI with Pydantic v2, SQLAlchemy 2 (async) over asyncpg, Alembic migrations, PostgreSQL, structlog, and an optional Kafka ingest pipeline that falls back to a simulator when no broker is configured.
Auth: JWT (HS256) with refresh-token rotation, passlib + bcrypt, pyotp TOTP two-factor, magic links, and Have I Been Pwned range-API password screening.
AI: this chat streams from Amazon Bedrock over server-sent events, with prompt caching on the system prompt and per-turn token and latency telemetry.

Build and deploy: esbuild produces a bundled, minified, content-hashed dist/; GitHub Actions runs lint, tests and migration drift checks, then rsyncs to EC2 (Apache for the static tier, systemd + Uvicorn for the API) with automatic rollback.

Side projects on the same domain: a Champions League bracket predictor at /ucl, a retired World Cup predictor at /worldcup, and an arcade at /arcade with 2048, Tetris, Flapper, Stack, Snake and Breaker — all written from scratch in vanilla JavaScript with no game engine.
